meta_description:
16K likes, 80 comments - barkhasingh0308 on July 16, 2026: "Wardrobe staples for heels 👠 - My recommendations from my own shoe closet (so please excuse me if some of them are a little dirty). 

These are the basics you should have in your heel collection before you explore statement pairs. Maybe I’ll do another video on Statement heel recommendations later! Let me know 🤗

A black stiletto, a nude pump or a sandal, a pop coloured heel in your favourite colour and the essential metallic. You have these, and you’re set for formal events, casual brunches, weekend gatherings, shaadi, festivals, office - basically everything!!".
